frozen_channel.channel: AWGN after ordinary front-end tracking, plus zero or one persistent residual ±pi/2 phase-state jump
frozen_channel.code_constraint: binary membership-testable; practical gate restricted to orbit-screened codes with redundancy 16 or 24
frozen_channel.jump_location: intra-packet, nonuniform or uniform, tested separately
frozen_channel.modulation: QPSK with sign labeling; alternative labeling only as an explicit orbit-control variable
